visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A group of young children in light blue and white baseball uniforms practice on a bright, sunny outdoor field. One child in a black helmet swings a bat with focus, while others are seen running and fielding in various shots against a background of green hills and a clear blue sky. (2) A male coach wearing a 'LEOPARD 58' jersey stands on the red dirt infield, speaking to a group of young players. The children listen attentively, wearing their team caps and uniforms, with the surrounding sports stadium infrastructure and lighting towers visible in the depth of the shot. (3) A large group of children jogs together in a tight formation across the grass, led by a coach. They are all smiling and energetic, wearing matching light blue jerseys. The camera captures them from a low angle as they move toward the viewer in the bright daylight. (4) Scenes transition to children sitting and eating healthy meals from bowls, followed by a female coach showing a whiteboard with handwritten notes to a seated audience of kids. The setting moves between the active field and shaded dugout areas with simple furniture. (5) Adults in casual athletic wear are seen running on the baseball diamond alongside the children in a parent-child activity. The final scene shows the entire group posing for a team photo, followed by a yellow graphic slide displaying a QR code and informational text.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Upbeat, energetic pop music with a strong acoustic guitar rhythm and electronic percussion starts. A male narrator begins speaking in a clear, professional, and welcoming tone. The audio is crisp with very low outdoor ambient noise in the mix. (2) The narrator's speech rate remains steady and conversational. As the visuals show kids running and sliding, the BGM maintains a high arousal level to match the energetic visual montage. There are no sudden peaks or technical distortions. (3) Subtle whoosh sound effects are used to punctuate transitions between different scenes of training and eating. The narrator's voice has a slightly rising intonation at the end of phrases to maintain viewer engagement and excitement. (4) The audio concludes with a direct call to action. The music continues at its established tempo and then fades out smoothly after the narrator finish speaking, providing a professional and polished promotional finish.
